claim_boundary: DIRAC-015 completes the conditional free-Dirac continuum derivation. DIRAC-016 proves scoped cube-copy exchange. DIRAC-017 proves the conditional cubical spin-one-half representation and continuous-angle Hamiltonian covariance only in the stated derived sector. DIRAC-018 gives a scoped local factorization classification and does not classify arbitrary nonlocal or flavor-mixing roots. DIRAC-019/020 prove finite spectral and coherent spatial transport, but not a uniform fixed-physical-time convergence rate. DIRAC-021 derives the action-selected rest phases and native frequency 19; a pure branch's global phase is not claimed to be an observable clock. DIRAC-022 derives the free-continuum zitterbewegung expectation and its exact amplitude-frequency scale lock. DIRAC-023 evaluates the existing plane-wave phase along the independently derived current trajectory and proves directional group/phase velocity reciprocity, energy/clock reciprocity, and the standard relativistic clock slowdown in the same continuum sector. The chain does not establish an exact finite-spacing phase-harmony law, a localized nonlinear native electron trajectory, an SI frequency or length, electromagnetic coupling or g-factor, unrestricted live-chi localized electron transport, electron identity or formation, or canonical LFM status.
